analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: with patience and determination 是“耐心且坚定地工作”。and 把 determination 和名词 patience 并列。determined 描述人，determinedly 修饰动作，determine 是动词，都不能在这里与 patience 同样接在 with 后。

analysis.exam_tip: confusion 是指导不足的结果；比较 guidance 和“一位向导”的词形用法。

选词补全句子。

analysis.exam_tip: 这里的 time 表示花费的时长；检查数量表达是否适合不可数的量。

front.context:

选词补全句子。

front.context:

选词补全句子。

analysis.exam_tip: reduce 降低的是什么？把 the _____ of failure 作为一个整体看。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The experiment revealed a clear _____ between light levels and plant growth.

front.support:

front.context:

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: a relationship between light levels and plant growth 是“光照强度与植物生长的关系”。relationship 是名词；related 是形容词，relate 是动词，relatively 是“相对地”。这里只说有联系，不能据此断言一个必然导致另一个。
analysis.exam_tip: between A and B 后列出光照与生长；空格需要能表示两者之间的关系。

选词补全句子。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The organisers checked every application _____ before announcing the results.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The organisers checked every application _____ before announcing the results.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The organisers checked every application _____ before announcing the results.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: checked every application carefully 是“认真检查每份申请”。carefully 描述检查的方式；careful 常描述人，如 careful reviewers。care 是“关心、照料”，caring 常指关爱的，不能替换这里修饰 checked 的副词。
analysis.exam_tip: application 已是被检查的对象；空格要说明检查做得怎样。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The new route is _____ shorter, so the expected time saving is small.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The new route is _____ shorter, so the expected time saving is small.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The new route is _____ shorter, so the expected time saving is small.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: slightly shorter 是“只短了一点”，因此节省的时间也不多。slightly 修饰比较级 shorter；slight、slighter 都是形容词，slightness 是名词，不能放在 shorter 前表示差别大小。
analysis.exam_tip: 后面的 time saving is small 说明 shorter 的幅度不大。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The library has _____ extended its weekend opening hours.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The library has _____ extended its weekend opening hours.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The library has _____ extended its weekend opening hours.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: has recently extended 是“最近延长了”。has extended 已组成动作，recently 只补发生时间。recent 描述名词，如 recent changes；recency 是“近期性”，new 是“新的”，都不能放在这里说明何时延长。
analysis.exam_tip: 先连读 has extended；中间的词只补这件事发生的时间。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The speakers were _____ praised for explaining the issue without unnecessary jargon.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The speakers were _____ praised for explaining the issue without unnecessary jargon.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The speakers were _____ praised for explaining the issue without unnecessary jargon.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: were widely praised 是“受到广泛称赞”。were praised 已表示被称赞，widely 修饰称赞的范围；不能看见 were 就选形容词 wide。width 是宽度，widen 是变宽，都不能表达这里的广泛赞扬。
analysis.exam_tip: 先把 were 和 praised 连起来；空格并不是单独接在 were 后描述演讲者。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
Demand rose _____, from ten requests a week to more than a hundred.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Demand rose _____, from ten requests a week to more than a hundred.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Demand rose _____, from ten requests a week to more than a hundred.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 每周需求从十次变成一百多次，是 rose sharply（大幅增长）。sharply 描述 rose 的幅度；sharp 描述名词，如 a sharp rise，sharpness 是名词，sharpen 是使变锋利的动词。
analysis.exam_tip: 先比较 ten 和 more than a hundred，再看哪个词能修饰 rose。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The two teams worked _____ but reached similar conclusions.

选出最自然的书面表达。
front.support:
The two teams worked _____ but reached similar conclusions.

选出最自然的书面表达。
front.context:
The two teams worked _____ but reached similar conclusions.

选出最自然的书面表达。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: worked independently 是书面语中“各自独立开展工作”的常见表达，与后面却得出相近结论形成对照。independent 通常直接描述团队，如 The teams are independent；independence 是名词，depend 是动词。
analysis.exam_tip: but 连接独立开展工作与得到相似结果；空格说明 worked 的方式。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The proposal is _____ practical, but its initial cost is higher than expected.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The proposal is _____ practical, but its initial cost is higher than expected.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The proposal is _____ practical, but its initial cost is higher than expected.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: technically practical 是“从技术角度看可行”，但费用仍然偏高。technically 限定评价角度，不表示所有方面都合适。technical 是形容词，technique 是技术方法，technician 是技术人员，都不能这样修饰 practical。
analysis.exam_tip: but 后谈成本；空格应说明 practical 只针对哪个方面。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The guide explains each step _____ so that new users can follow it.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The guide explains each step _____ so that new users can follow it.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The guide explains each step _____ so that new users can follow it.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: explains each step clearly 是“把每一步解释清楚”，新用户才能照着做。clearly 修饰 explains；clear 可以说 clear instructions，clarity 是“清晰度”，cleared 是动词过去形式，不适合此处。
analysis.exam_tip: so that 后写了效果：新用户能跟上。空格说明解释的方式。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The equipment was _____ damaged and had to be replaced.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The equipment was _____ damaged and had to be replaced.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The equipment was _____ damaged and had to be replaced.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: severely damaged 是“损坏严重”，因此不得不更换。severely 修饰 damaged；severe 可以说 severe damage，severity 是严重程度，severer 是形容词比较级，不能这样直接修饰 damaged。
analysis.exam_tip: had to be replaced 给出后果；它提示损坏到了什么程度。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 词性判断
front.prompt:
The train arrived _____, ten minutes before its scheduled time.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The train arrived _____, ten minutes before its scheduled time.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The train arrived _____, ten minutes before its scheduled time.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 比计划提前十分钟到达，用 arrived early。early 本身能作副词，不需要另加 -ly。earliness 是早到这件事，premature 指过早、不成熟，previous 是先前的，都不能代替这里表示提前到站的 early。
analysis.exam_tip: ten minutes before 给出与计划时间的比较；不要只凭 -ly 判断副词。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The committee postponed its _____ until Friday.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The committee postponed its _____ until Friday.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The committee postponed its _____ until Friday.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: postponed its decision 是“推迟作出决定”，decision 表示被推迟的事情。its 后接这一名词；decide 是动作，decisive 是“果断的”，decisively 是“果断地”，都不能单独表示被推迟的决定。
analysis.exam_tip: 委员会把什么推迟到了星期五？its 后需要能表示这件事的词。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
Before approving the plan, the council requested a detailed _____ of its likely costs.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Before approving the plan, the council requested a detailed _____ of its likely costs.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Before approving the plan, the council requested a detailed _____ of its likely costs.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: a detailed assessment of its likely costs 是“对预计成本的详细评估”。assessment 是要求提交的评估内容；assess 是动作，assessing 不能直接跟在 a detailed 后这样使用，assessable 是“可评估的”。
analysis.exam_tip: 审批前索要的是一份评估；of its likely costs 指明评估对象。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The extra staff brought immediate _____ from the pressure of the busy season.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The extra staff brought immediate _____ from the pressure of the busy season.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The extra staff brought immediate _____ from the pressure of the busy season.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: brought relief from the pressure 是“缓解了压力”：增加人手后，旺季工作负担减轻了。relief 是这种缓解；relieve 是减轻的动作，relieved 描述人松了口气，relieving 不能单独接在 immediate 后表示这种效果。
analysis.exam_tip: immediate 描述增加人手后立即产生的效果；from 后给出要缓解的压力。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
Uncertainty about the rules became a major _____ for new applicants.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Uncertainty about the rules became a major _____ for new applicants.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Uncertainty about the rules became a major _____ for new applicants.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: a major concern 是“一个主要担忧”。申请者不清楚规则，这件事成了他们的顾虑。concern 是名词；concerned 描述人担心，concerning 常表示令人担心的，concerningly 是副词，都不能单独接在 a major 后。
analysis.exam_tip: a major _____ 是规则不清带来的一个问题，不是直接描述申请者怎样。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The unused rooms provide new _____ for community activities.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The unused rooms provide new _____ for community activities.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The unused rooms provide new _____ for community activities.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: provide new space for community activities 是“提供新的社区活动空间”。space 指可使用的地方；spacious 是宽敞的，spatial 是空间方面的，spatially 是副词，都不能单独指这些空房间提供的场地。
analysis.exam_tip: for community activities 表示用途；空房间能提供给活动什么？

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
A persistent _____ in opening hours makes cooperation between the two offices difficult.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
A persistent _____ in opening hours makes cooperation between the two offices difficult.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
A persistent _____ in opening hours makes cooperation between the two offices difficult.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: a persistent difference in opening hours 是“开放时间长期存在的差异”，它使两个办公室难以协作。difference 指这种差异；different 描述东西不同，differ 是动词，differently 是副词。
analysis.exam_tip: 先找到已经存在的动词 makes；空格属于导致协作困难的那个原因。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The course demonstrates the practical _____ of learning to evaluate evidence.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The course demonstrates the practical _____ of learning to evaluate evidence.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The course demonstrates the practical _____ of learning to evaluate evidence.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: the practical value of learning to evaluate evidence 是“学会评估证据的实际价值”。value 指这项技能的用处。valuable 表示有价值的，valued 是受重视的，valuably 是副词，都不能代替 the practical 后所需的名词。
analysis.exam_tip: practical 已经表示实际的；of 后说明哪种学习有这个价值。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
Finding affordable accommodation became a serious _____ for students arriving late.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Finding affordable accommodation became a serious _____ for students arriving late.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Finding affordable accommodation became a serious _____ for students arriving late.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: a serious challenge 是“一项严峻挑战”：晚到的学生很难找到负担得起的住处。challenge 指这件难事；challenging 可说 Finding accommodation is challenging，但本句有 a serious，后面要保留名词。
analysis.exam_tip: 别只看 became；连着读 a serious _____，看这里指一件什么事。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
Sudden _____ in the timetable left several participants unable to attend.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Sudden _____ in the timetable left several participants unable to attend.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Sudden _____ in the timetable left several participants unable to attend.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: Sudden changes in the timetable 指“时刻表的突然变动”，这些变动使人无法参加。left 才是全句的主要动词。changeable 是易变的，changed 描述已改过的，changing 不能与后面的 in 这样指代几次变动。
analysis.exam_tip: 先读空格后面的 in the timetable，再找句子的动词 left。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
A shortage of trained _____ delayed the opening of the new centre.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
A shortage of trained _____ delayed the opening of the new centre.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
A shortage of trained _____ delayed the opening of the new centre.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: trained personnel 是“受过培训的工作人员”，缺人导致中心延期开放。personnel 指人员；personal 是个人的，personally 是亲自或就个人而言，personify 是使人格化，都不表示这里缺少的员工。
analysis.exam_tip: trained 描述受过培训的谁；不要把 personnel 和 personal 当作同一个词。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The explanation seems _____, but it leaves one important question unanswered.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The explanation seems _____, but it leaves one important question unanswered.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The explanation seems _____, but it leaves one important question unanswered.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: seems convincing 是“看起来有说服力”，但仍有问题没回答。convincing 描述 explanation 给人的效果；convincingly 修饰说、解释等动作，convince 是说服，conviction 是信念，不能这样直接接在 seems 后。
analysis.exam_tip: seems 表示看起来怎样；but 后提醒这份解释仍有缺口。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
Students found the revised timetable _____ because it left enough time to travel between classes.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Students found the revised timetable _____ because it left enough time to travel between classes.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Students found the revised timetable _____ because it left enough time to travel between classes.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: found the timetable practical 是“觉得时间表切实可行”。课间有足够赶路时间，正是可行的理由。practical 描述 timetable；practically 是副词，practice 是练习或实践，practise 是练习的动词，均不合此处。
analysis.exam_tip: because 后的足够赶路时间，是学生评价 timetable 的具体依据。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The organisers consider the current room _____ for a meeting of two hundred people.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The organisers consider the current room _____ for a meeting of two hundred people.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The organisers consider the current room _____ for a meeting of two hundred people.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: consider the room inadequate 是“认为房间不能满足需要”。for a meeting of two hundred people 说明要满足的需求。inadequate 描述房间；inadequacy、adequacy 是名词，inadequately 是副词，不能放在这里直接评价 room。
analysis.exam_tip: 组织者评价的是 room 是否容得下二百人的会议。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The residents remained _____ about the proposal until they saw a clear funding plan.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The residents remained _____ about the proposal until they saw a clear funding plan.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The residents remained _____ about the proposal until they saw a clear funding plan.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: remained sceptical about the proposal 是“对提议一直有怀疑”，直到看到清楚的资金计划。sceptical 描述居民态度；scepticism 是怀疑这件事，sceptically 是副词，单数 sceptic 也不能直接指复数 residents。
analysis.exam_tip: until 后的资金计划改变了居民态度；此前他们对提议怎样？

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
A more _____ schedule would allow volunteers to choose between morning and evening shifts.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
A more _____ schedule would allow volunteers to choose between morning and evening shifts.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
A more _____ schedule would allow volunteers to choose between morning and evening shifts.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: a more flexible schedule 是“更灵活的时间安排”，具体表现是志愿者能选早班或晚班。flexible 描述 schedule；flexibility 是灵活性，flexibly 是副词，flexing 是弯曲或活动的动作，不适合这里。
analysis.exam_tip: choose between morning and evening shifts 是判断安排性质的线索。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The findings were _____ with the pattern observed in the earlier survey.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The findings were _____ with the pattern observed in the earlier survey.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The findings were _____ with the pattern observed in the earlier survey.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: were consistent with the earlier pattern 表示“与先前调查发现的规律一致”。consistent 描述 findings 和既有规律的关系；consistency 是一致性，consist 是动词，consistently 是副词，不能填入这里。
analysis.exam_tip: with 后提供拿来比较的旧规律；空格说明新发现与它的关系。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The new entrance makes the museum more _____ to wheelchair users.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The new entrance makes the museum more _____ to wheelchair users.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The new entrance makes the museum more _____ to wheelchair users.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: makes the museum more accessible to wheelchair users 是“使博物馆更方便轮椅使用者进入”。accessible 描述改建后的状态；access 是进入机会，accessibility 是可达性，accessibly 是副词，不能接在 museum more 后这样使用。
analysis.exam_tip: 新入口改变的是轮椅使用者能否方便进入，而非博物馆的名字或地点。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The participants found the instructions _____ because several key steps were missing.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The participants found the instructions _____ because several key steps were missing.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The participants found the instructions _____ because several key steps were missing.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: found the instructions confusing 是“觉得说明让人困惑”，因为关键步骤漏写了。confusing 描述说明造成的感受；若说参与者感到困惑，则用 confused。confusion 是名词，confuse 是动词，confusingly 是副词。
analysis.exam_tip: 空格描述 instructions 造成的效果；人感到困惑与说明令人困惑不是同一词形。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The final paragraph appeared _____ to readers who had not seen the earlier explanation.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The final paragraph appeared _____ to readers who had not seen the earlier explanation.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The final paragraph appeared _____ to readers who had not seen the earlier explanation.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: appeared ambiguous 是“显得含糊、有不止一种理解”。读者没看前面的解释，因此难以确定最后一段的意思。ambiguous 描述段落；ambiguity、ambiguities 是名词，ambiguously 是副词。
analysis.exam_tip: appeared 在这里接近 seemed；它不是说段落突然出现，而是说读者觉得它怎样。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The new reminder system proved _____ in reducing missed appointments.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The new reminder system proved _____ in reducing missed appointments.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The new reminder system proved _____ in reducing missed appointments.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: proved effective in reducing missed appointments 是“证明对减少失约有效”。proved 在这里相当于“结果表明是”，后面用 effective 评价系统；effect、effectiveness 是名词，effectively 是副词。
analysis.exam_tip: 系统有什么效果？in reducing missed appointments 给出了评价的具体方面。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The team may _____ the figures tomorrow, but no check has been scheduled yet.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The team may _____ the figures tomorrow, but no check has been scheduled yet.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The team may _____ the figures tomorrow, but no check has been scheduled yet.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: may verify the figures tomorrow 是“明天可能核对数据”。may 后用 verify 原形；verified、verifying 不能直接接在 may 后，verification 是名词。后半句还没安排核对，不能把 may 理解成已经核对或一定会核对。
analysis.exam_tip: may 只表示可能；tomorrow 与尚未安排的检查也要一起读。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The organisers have _____ the venue after comparing three alternatives.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The organisers have _____ the venue after comparing three alternatives.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The organisers have _____ the venue after comparing three alternatives.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: have selected the venue 表示“已经选好了场地”。have 后需要 selected 这个过去分词；select 原形、selecting、selection 都不能代替。after comparing three alternatives 交代做选择前的比较，不改变 have selected。
analysis.exam_tip: 先连读 have _____ the venue；after 后面只是补充选择前做了什么。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
New volunteers need to _____ the safety procedure before their first shift.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
New volunteers need to _____ the safety procedure before their first shift.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
New volunteers need to _____ the safety procedure before their first shift.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: need to understand the safety procedure 是“需要理解安全流程”。to 后用 understand 原形；understood 是过去式或过去分词，understanding 是 -ing 形式，understandable 是“可理解的”，都不能替代此处动作。
analysis.exam_tip: 新志愿者上岗前需要做什么？need to 后要接这个动作。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The notice usually _____ the time and place of the next meeting.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The notice usually _____ the time and place of the next meeting.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The notice usually _____ the time and place of the next meeting.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: notice 是单数，usually 表示通常如此，因此写 The notice usually includes ...。include 缺少第三人称 -s；including 不能独立作本句谓语，inclusion 是“包含”这个名词。
analysis.exam_tip: 通常包含信息的是 The notice；后面的 time and place 不是主语。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The teacher has _____ each student to bring one question to the discussion.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The teacher has _____ each student to bring one question to the discussion.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The teacher has _____ each student to bring one question to the discussion.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: has asked each student to bring a question 是“已经要求每位学生带一个问题”。has 后用 asked；ask、asking、question 都不能与 has 组成这个已完成的要求。to bring 再说明老师要求学生做什么。
analysis.exam_tip: 把 has _____ 与后面的 each student to bring 分开看：谁提出要求，要求做什么？

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The new system is expected to _____ waiting times at busy periods.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The new system is expected to _____ waiting times at busy periods.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The new system is expected to _____ waiting times at busy periods.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: is expected to reduce waiting times 是“预计会减少等候时间”。is expected 已表示被预期，to 后再用 reduce 原形表达预期的动作；reduction 是名词，reduced、reducing 都不合这个位置。
analysis.exam_tip: 不要把 is 直接连到空格；先读完整的 is expected to。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The manager did _____ the timetable before the tickets were sold.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The manager did _____ the timetable before the tickets were sold.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The manager did _____ the timetable before the tickets were sold.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: did check 表示“确实检查过”。did 已经表示过去，后面的 check 恢复原形，不能再用 checked，也不用 checks 或 checking。这里 did 的作用是强调检查确实发生过。
analysis.exam_tip: did 是否已经标明过去？避免让后面的动词再变化一次。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
A booking error can _____ unnecessary delays for a large group.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
A booking error can _____ unnecessary delays for a large group.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
A booking error can _____ unnecessary delays for a large group.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: can cause delays 是“可能造成延误”。can 后用 cause 原形，不管主语 error 是单数，还是宾语 delays 是复数，都不改成 causes。caused、causing 也不能直接接在 can 后。
analysis.exam_tip: 决定空格形式的是 can；不要按 error 或 delays 的单复数直接加词尾。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The museum is planning to _____ more signs near the entrance.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The museum is planning to _____ more signs near the entrance.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The museum is planning to _____ more signs near the entrance.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: is planning to install signs 是“计划安装标识”。to 后用 install 原形；installation 是安装这件事，installed、installing 不能代替。前面的 planning 已有 -ing，不代表后一个动词也要加 -ing。
analysis.exam_tip: planning 和空格不是并列动词；to 把计划要做的事引出来。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
Once the new term begins, the library will _____ open later on weekdays.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Once the new term begins, the library will _____ open later on weekdays.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Once the new term begins, the library will _____ open later on weekdays.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: will remain open later 是“将延长保持开放的时间”。will 后用 remain 原形，open 描述继续保持的状态。remains 不因 library 单数就能放在 will 后；remained、remaining 也不符合这里的形式。
analysis.exam_tip: will 后先找动作原形，open 已经说明图书馆保持什么状态。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The speakers can _____ explain the problem without specialised terms.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The speakers can _____ explain the problem without specialised terms.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The speakers can _____ explain the problem without specialised terms.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: can clearly explain 是“能清楚地解释”。can 后真正的动词已经是 explain，中间加 clearly 说明解释方式。不能看见 can 就在空格里选 clear 原形；clarity 是名词，cleared 是过去形式。
analysis.exam_tip: 先把 can 与 explain 连起来，空格只是在两者之间补充方式。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The queue moved _____ once a second service desk opened.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The queue moved _____ once a second service desk opened.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The queue moved _____ once a second service desk opened.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 第二个服务台开放后，队伍移动得快，用 moved quickly。书面语通常用 quickly 修饰 moved；quick 常描述事物，如 a quick response。quickness 是名词，quicker than 后还缺比较对象。
analysis.exam_tip: moved 已是动作；空格说队伍移动得怎样，than 后是否还有比较对象？

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The older building remains _____ vulnerable to flooding.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The older building remains _____ vulnerable to flooding.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The older building remains _____ vulnerable to flooding.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: particularly vulnerable to flooding 是“尤其容易受洪水影响”。vulnerable 已描述建筑的状态，particularly 只加强程度。particular 是形容词，particulars 指细节，particularity 是名词，都不能这样修饰 vulnerable。
analysis.exam_tip: remains 后已有 vulnerable；空格要修饰这个形容词。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
_____, the two surveys used different questions, so their results should not be compared directly.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
_____, the two surveys used different questions, so their results should not be compared directly.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
_____, the two surveys used different questions, so their results should not be compared directly.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: Unfortunately 在句首表示“遗憾的是”，评价后面两个调查无法直接比较的情况。后面已有完整句子，不能只放形容词 Unfortunate；Misfortune 是不幸的事，Unfortunates 指不幸的人，都不作这种句首评语。
analysis.exam_tip: 逗号后已经有完整句子；空格要对整件事作评价。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
Staff now review the timetable more _____ after several recent delays.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Staff now review the timetable more _____ after several recent delays.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Staff now review the timetable more _____ after several recent delays.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: review the timetable more frequently 是“更频繁地检查时刻表”。more frequently 描述检查的频率。frequent 描述频繁发生的事，frequency、frequencies 是频率的名词，不能放在这里直接修饰 review。
analysis.exam_tip: more 后不一定是形容词；先看空格描述 review 的频率还是 timetable 的性质。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The team responded _____ to the warning and moved the event indoors.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The team responded _____ to the warning and moved the event indoors.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The team responded _____ to the warning and moved the event indoors.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: responded promptly 是“及时作出回应”，随后把活动移到室内。promptly 修饰 responded；prompt 可说 a prompt response，promptness 是及时性，prompted 是动词形式，均不适合此处。
analysis.exam_tip: 收到警告后很快搬到室内；空格说明反应有多及时。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The results were _____ interpreted by teams using different definitions.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The results were _____ interpreted by teams using different definitions.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The results were _____ interpreted by teams using different definitions.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: were differently interpreted 是“被作出不同解读”。不同团队采用不同定义，解读方式因而不同。were interpreted 已是被动表达，空格用 differently 修饰它；different 描述名词，difference、differences 是差异的名词。
analysis.exam_tip: 先找完整的 were interpreted，再看 different definitions 如何影响解读。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The team estimated the likely costs too _____ and later ran out of money.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The team estimated the likely costs too _____ and later ran out of money.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The team estimated the likely costs too _____ and later ran out of money.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: estimated the costs too optimistically 是“对成本估计得过于乐观”，后面钱不够用说明预算估低了。optimistically 描述 estimated 的方式；optimistic 描述人或估计，optimism 是乐观，optimist 是乐观的人。
analysis.exam_tip: 钱后来用完了；too 后的词要说明估算时采取了什么态度。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
After the first failure, the group proceeded _____ and checked each stage before moving on.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
After the first failure, the group proceeded _____ and checked each stage before moving on.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
After the first failure, the group proceeded _____ and checked each stage before moving on.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: proceeded cautiously 是“小心地继续推进”。每一步都检查后再继续，正是谨慎的表现。cautious 描述人或做法，caution 是小心或警告，cautioning 是警告的动作，不能直接修饰 proceeded。
analysis.exam_tip: checked each stage before moving on 是判断推进方式的证据。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 空格语法预判
front.prompt:
The new process reduced waiting times _____, from an hour to about ten minutes.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The new process reduced waiting times _____, from an hour to about ten minutes.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The new process reduced waiting times _____, from an hour to about ten minutes.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 等候从一小时缩短到十分钟左右，是 reduced substantially（大幅减少）。substantially 修饰 reduced 的幅度。substantial 可说 a substantial reduction；substance、substances 表示物质等含义，不能表达这里的程度。
analysis.exam_tip: 比较 an hour 和 ten minutes，再判断减少的幅度。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
Reliable public transport can result _____ shorter journeys for residents.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Reliable public transport can result _____ shorter journeys for residents.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Reliable public transport can result _____ shorter journeys for residents.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: result in shorter journeys 是“使行程变短”：公共交通可靠是原因，行程缩短是结果。result from 的方向相反，后面接原因；of、at 都不合此处搭配。先分清原因和结果，再选介词。
analysis.exam_tip: shorter journeys 是交通改善带来的结果，还是交通改善的原因？

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The delay stemmed _____ a fault in the signalling system.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The delay stemmed _____ a fault in the signalling system.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The delay stemmed _____ a fault in the signalling system.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: stemmed from a fault 是“源于一次故障”。句子先说延误，再交代信号系统故障这个原因，所以用 from。stem to、stem in、stem with 都不表示这里的“由……引起”。
analysis.exam_tip: 先有信号故障，才发生延误；空格后交代的是起因。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
All visitors must comply _____ the museum rules.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
All visitors must comply _____ the museum rules.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
All visitors must comply _____ the museum rules.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: comply with the museum rules 是“遵守博物馆规定”，with 是这个动词搭配的一部分。to、at、of 都不能替代这里的 with。可与 follow the rules 对照：follow 直接接 rules，comply 需要 with。
analysis.exam_tip: 比较 comply _____ the rules 与 follow the rules，别把两个动词的接法混用。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The council plans to phase _____ the oldest buses over the next five years.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The council plans to phase _____ the oldest buses over the next five years.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The council plans to phase _____ the oldest buses over the next five years.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: phase out the oldest buses 是“逐步淘汰最旧的公交车”。over the next five years 表明过程分几年进行，不是一次全换掉。phase over、off、away 不能表达这里的逐步停止使用。
analysis.exam_tip: five years 说明变化分阶段发生；老公交是被投入使用还是被淘汰？

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The volunteers will carry _____ a survey of local travel needs.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The volunteers will carry _____ a survey of local travel needs.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The volunteers will carry _____ a survey of local travel needs.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: carry out a survey 是“开展、实施调查”。carry off 可表示赢得或成功完成难事，carry over 是延续到以后，carry away 是带走；这里要说执行调查，选 out。
analysis.exam_tip: survey 是计划要实施的工作，不是要搬走的物品。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The calculation should take maintenance costs _____ account.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The calculation should take maintenance costs _____ account.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The calculation should take maintenance costs _____ account.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: take maintenance costs into account 是“把维护费用考虑进去”。maintenance costs 放在 take 和 into account 中间。onto 表示到某表面上，from 表示来自，with 表示伴随，都不构成这个考虑因素的搭配。
analysis.exam_tip: 先把中间的 maintenance costs 暂时遮住，读 take _____ account。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
Equipment faults account _____ most of the delays recorded this month.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Equipment faults account _____ most of the delays recorded this month.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Equipment faults account _____ most of the delays recorded this month.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: equipment faults account for most delays 是“多数延误由设备故障造成”。account for 在这里解释延误的原因，不是说故障主动承担责任；to、with、by 都不合 account for 这一用法。
analysis.exam_tip: 本句在回答“大多数延误由什么造成”，不是问谁负责处理延误。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
A lack of clear signs can lead _____ confusion at a busy station.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
A lack of clear signs can lead _____ confusion at a busy station.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
A lack of clear signs can lead _____ confusion at a busy station.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: lead to confusion 是“导致混乱”。缺少标识是原因，confusion 是结果；to 把结果接出来。from 会把方向弄反，of、with 也不合这个搭配。这里 to 后接名词，并不要求动词原形。
analysis.exam_tip: 标识不足和混乱，哪一个在前、哪一个是后果？

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The organisers decided to step _____ their publicity before the event.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The organisers decided to step _____ their publicity before the event.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The organisers decided to step _____ their publicity before the event.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: step up publicity 是“加大宣传力度”。这里的 step up 不是往上迈一步，而是加强某项工作。step away 是离开，step over 是跨过，step through 是逐步执行，均不表达加强宣传。
analysis.exam_tip: publicity 是活动前要加强的工作；把 step 当短语理解，不要逐字译成迈步。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The committee will look _____ the complaints before making a decision.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The committee will look _____ the complaints before making a decision.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The committee will look _____ the complaints before making a decision.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: look into the complaints 是“调查这些投诉”，调查后再作决定。look after 是照顾，look out 是当心，look up to 是敬重；它们都不能表达委员会核查投诉的动作。
analysis.exam_tip: before making a decision 说明委员会要先查清投诉的情况。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The path was closed after _____ rain flooded several low sections.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The path was closed after _____ rain flooded several low sections.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The path was closed after _____ rain flooded several low sections.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The new system is faster. _____ the other hand, it costs more to maintain.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The new system is faster. _____ the other hand, it costs more to maintain.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The new system is faster. _____ the other hand, it costs more to maintain.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: On the other hand 是“另一方面”：前面说速度快，后面补充维护成本高。它把优点和代价放在一起比较，不是说更快导致更贵。In、At、By 不属于这个固定表达。
analysis.exam_tip: faster 和 costs more 是评价系统的两个方面，后句补充的是代价。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
Although the repair costs more now, it should save money in the _____ run.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
Although the repair costs more now, it should save money in the _____ run.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
Although the repair costs more now, it should save money in the _____ run.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: in the long run 表示“从长远看”。现在维修花费多，但以后能省钱，形成眼前与长期的对照。wide、deep、large 都不能替换这个时间表达里的 long。
analysis.exam_tip: now 和后面的 should save money 在比较眼前费用与以后收益。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
_____ regard to opening hours, the library will publish a separate notice.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
_____ regard to opening hours, the library will publish a separate notice.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
_____ regard to opening hours, the library will publish a separate notice.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: With regard to opening hours 是“关于开放时间”。整段先限定通知讨论的话题；At、From、For 都不能直接放进 _____ regard to。也可另说 regarding opening hours，但那时不再用 regard to。
analysis.exam_tip: 后面要发一份单独通知，开头先交代通知谈哪件事。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The first route is direct. _____ contrast, the second involves two changes of bus.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The first route is direct. _____ contrast, the second involves two changes of bus.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The first route is direct. _____ contrast, the second involves two changes of bus.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: By contrast 表示“相比之下”。第一条线直达，第二条要换两次车，后句突出这种差别。At、On、To 不合这个独立连接语；in contrast 也是正确说法，但本题没有 In 选项。
analysis.exam_tip: direct 与 two changes of bus 是要比较的差别，不是前因后果。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
_____ spite of the rain, the volunteers completed the outdoor work.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
_____ spite of the rain, the volunteers completed the outdoor work.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
_____ spite of the rain, the volunteers completed the outdoor work.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: In spite of the rain 是“尽管下雨”。下雨本来妨碍室外工作，但志愿者还是完成了，所以用让步表达 in spite of。后面直接接 rain 这个名词；At、By、For 不合该短语。
analysis.exam_tip: 下雨与完成室外工作构成“本来受阻，却仍完成”的关系。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The organisers acted in _____ to repeated complaints about the noise.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The organisers acted in _____ to repeated complaints about the noise.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The organisers acted in _____ to repeated complaints about the noise.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: in response to complaints 是“回应投诉”。in 与 to 之间用名词 response；respond 是“回应”的动作，responsive 是“反应积极的”，responsively 是副词，均不能替代短语里的 response。
analysis.exam_tip: 这里要认出完整的 in _____ to；空格不是句子的第二个谓语。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
In the short _____, the repairs may cause disruption, but access should improve later.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
In the short _____, the repairs may cause disruption, but access should improve later.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
In the short _____, the repairs may cause disruption, but access should improve later.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: In the short term 是“短期内”。维修眼下可能带来不便，later 则会改善通行，前后对照的是两个时间阶段。short time 常说一小段时间，但 in the short time 不能像本句这样直接作“短期来看”。
analysis.exam_tip: 把开头与 later 对照，找表示短期影响的固定说法。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 固定搭配
front.prompt:
The museum offers free entry. In _____, it provides a free audio guide.

选词补全句子。
front.support:
The museum offers free entry. In _____, it provides a free audio guide.

选词补全句子。
front.context:
The museum offers free entry. In _____, it provides a free audio guide.

选词补全句子。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: In addition 表示“此外”。前一句提供免费入场，后一句再增加免费语音导览这项服务。addition 是该短语中的名词；additional 表示额外的，add、adding 是动作形式，均不能单独组成这里的连接语。
analysis.exam_tip: 后一句是在免费入场之外再加一项服务，不是在解释原因。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 这封邮件要解决的是时间冲突。第一句回应邀请，第二句交代具体原因和不能参加的结果。实验课与邀请时间重合，比只说 I am busy 更清楚；无需把个人日程写成长篇论证。
analysis.exam_tip: 应用文先找读者需要知道的决定，再补足理由和必要细节。

card_records.back_text: Thank you for inviting me to Friday's feedback session. Unfortunately, I have a laboratory class at that time and will be unable to attend.

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 判断作文体裁
front.prompt: 图书馆通知你归还一本参考书，但论文答辩推迟到下周。请给管理员写两句邮件，请求延期七天，并表示愿意遵守规定。
front.support: 图书馆通知你归还一本参考书，但论文答辩推迟到下周。请给管理员写两句邮件，请求延期七天，并表示愿意遵守规定。
front.context: 图书馆通知你归还一本参考书，但论文答辩推迟到下周。请给管理员写两句邮件，请求延期七天，并表示愿意遵守规定。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 请求里同时包含动作 extend the loan 和期限 seven days，管理员才知道如何处理。subject to 表示延期取决于规定，不是单方面宣布延长。礼貌不等于模糊，省去期限反而降低沟通效率。
analysis.exam_tip: 请求句写清做什么、到何时，理由用来支持请求。

card_records.back_text: Could I extend the loan for seven days, as my thesis defence has been postponed until next week? I understand that the extension is subject to the library's lending policy.

front.prompt: 题目要求你代表学生会通知全校同学：旧书交换会周六上午十点在图书馆大厅举行，参加者最多带五本书。应该优先写活动的利弊，还是把行动信息写清楚？请用英文写通知的主体。
front.support: 题目要求你代表学生会通知全校同学：旧书交换会周六上午十点在图书馆大厅举行，参加者最多带五本书。应该优先写活动的利弊，还是把行动信息写清楚？请用英文写通知的主体。
front.context: 题目要求你代表学生会通知全校同学：旧书交换会周六上午十点在图书馆大厅举行，参加者最多带五本书。应该优先写活动的利弊，还是把行动信息写清楚？请用英文写通知的主体。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 代表组织发布通知，读者需要知道何时、何地以及携带上限。up to five 包含五本，不能写成 more than five。讨论旧书交换的利弊不能替代题目要求的活动安排。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 订单号和签收时间帮助定位交易，具体故障比 terrible quality 更便于处理。第二句提出明确补救，并询问退回流程。投诉中应区分可核实的事实与未经证明的质量判断。
analysis.exam_tip: 投诉按交易信息、具体故障、期望补救组织。

front.prompt: 你推荐同学 Maya 担任项目协调员。已知她按期组织过三次跨专业会议，并在会前发出议程。请写一句评价和一句支持事实。
front.support: 你推荐同学 Maya 担任项目协调员。已知她按期组织过三次跨专业会议，并在会前发出议程。请写一句评价和一句支持事实。
front.context: 你推荐同学 Maya 担任项目协调员。已知她按期组织过三次跨专业会议，并在会前发出议程。请写一句评价和一句支持事实。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: reliable 是评价，按期组织会议与提前发议程是可观察的支持事实。不要只堆 outstanding、excellent 等形容词，也不能由三次会议推断她具备所有管理技能。事实应直接支撑所推荐岗位需要的能力。
analysis.exam_tip: 推荐意见后紧跟与岗位相关的行为证据。

card_records.back_text: Maya would be a reliable project coordinator. She organised three interdisciplinary meetings on schedule and circulated an agenda before each one.

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 确认不是只回复 OK。复述时间和地点可以发现双方理解差异，最后询问材料要求则帮助会前准备。没有依据时不必承诺提交具体文件，也不要把询问写成对方已经要求的事项。
analysis.exam_tip: 确认安排时复述最容易产生误解的时间、地点和准备要求。

card_records.back_text: Thank you for arranging the meeting. I will be in Room 204 of Building B at 3 p.m. on Thursday; please let me know if I should send any materials in advance.

front.support: 学院征集海报设计，提交截止时间是4月12日中午，文件发到指定邮箱，优胜作品用于迎新活动。请写两句通知主体，不虚构邮箱地址或奖金。
front.context: 学院征集海报设计，提交截止时间是4月12日中午，文件发到指定邮箱，优胜作品用于迎新活动。请写两句通知主体，不虚构邮箱地址或奖金。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: by noon 表示截止到中午，而不是中午之后；designated email address 保留题目未给出的具体地址。不能自行增加奖金、格式或资格要求，应用文的信息准确性先于铺陈。
analysis.exam_tip: 通知中缺失的细节不能靠想象补成确定事实。

card_records.back_text: Students are invited to submit poster designs for the welcome event by noon on 12 April. Please send your file to the designated email address; the winning design will be used at the event.

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: checking the charts 和 spotting the two incorrect unit labels 说明感谢的具体帮助。第二句写这项帮助怎样让报告更清楚。题目没有给检查发生在提交前还是提交后，不额外加入 before submission。
analysis.exam_tip: 感谢信以具体帮助及其影响替代夸张赞美。

card_records.back_text: Thank you for checking the charts in my report and spotting the two incorrect unit labels. Your comments helped me correct the labels and make the results easier to interpret.

analysis.exam_tip: 申请材料中的能力主张应能对应具体经历。

card_records.back_text: I am writing to apply for the summer research assistant position. I am familiar with data cleaning and can work three days a week. Although I have not independently designed an experiment, I am willing to learn under supervision.
